items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: Steve Johns, who was on the drum track on that... Steve is an amazing cat to work with in the studio

ctx.x: To me that is such a terrific thing to do and not many people if they even think of doing it they wouldn’t do it anyway. And I think it’s worth noting from an arranger’s standpoint that within a quartet you’ve got all these possibilities of combinations. So I just wanted to say I’m glad you did it.

Well thank you. Thank you. It’s one of those things that happened. You know we plan for things and this was just one that we said you know, let’s try this. I want to try this. So we did it. And Steve Johns, who was on the drum track on that, Steve is an amazing cat to work with in the studio you know. His studio skills are second to none, really. He’s a great cat playing live with but in the studio his experience and knowledge and the way he connects, I keep using that word but it’s really a relevant term. The…
Yes and in the studio, it’s interesting you mention that because sometimes we can be separated, the drummer might be in a booth or something so they really have to be tuned in from their ears.
